cues.en: Now, we're going to be working with the fashion MNIST data set here.
cues.zh: 我們使用 Fashion-MNIST 資料集。

cues.en: So remember, the MNIST data set is just samples of people writing the digits zero through nine. Fashion MNIST amnesties the same idea, but instead of digits, we're going to have little pictures of pieces
cues.zh: 記得，MNIST 是人們寫零到九的樣本。Fashion-MNIST 概念相同，但不是數字，而是小張的

cues.en: of clothing.
cues.zh: 服裝影像。

cues.en: So instead of trying to classify what numbers somebody is writing, we're going to be classifying.
cues.zh: 因此，不是分類某人寫哪個數字，而是分類，

cues.en: Is this an image of a shirt or a pair of pants or a handbag or, you know, something like that?
cues.zh: 這是襯衫、褲子、手提包，或類似東西的影像嗎？

cues.en: It's a little bit more interesting twist on it.
cues.zh: 稍微有趣一點的變化。

cues.en: Let's start off by loading up that data sets by just calling fashion start low data.
cues.zh: 先呼叫 fashion_mnist.load_data，載入資料集。

cues.en: Fortunately, it's built into Keris for us.
cues.zh: 幸好，Keras 已經內建。

cues.en: So there's nothing we really have to do and we're going to transform that data a little bit.
cues.zh: 所以，不必特別做什麼，再稍微轉換資料。

cues.en: So a couple of things we're going to do first, we're going to merge together the training and test data together, why, you might ask, why are we going to not do train test?
cues.zh: 先做幾件事，第一，合併訓練與測試資料。你可能問，為什麼不做訓練／測試？

cues.en: Well, we're not trying to measure our accuracy in predicting the classification of an image here.
cues.zh: 因為這裡不是要衡量預測影像分類的準確率。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: Our objective is just to randomly create convincing looking images of pieces of clothing so that train and test set isn't really useful for us for that specific application.
cues.zh: 目標只是隨機建立可信的服裝影像，因此，這個特定應用，不太需要訓練／測試分割。

cues.en: So instead, I'm going to take advantage of that extra test data and throw it into my training set.
cues.zh: 我改用額外測試資料，把它加入訓練集。

cues.en: So I just have that much more data to train it with.
cues.zh: 就有更多訓練資料。

cues.en: Also, at the same time, I'm going to convert that data from zero to 255 pixel values where it represents a shade of grey, basically down to zero to one floating point values.
cues.zh: 同時，把代表灰階的零到 255 像素值，轉成零到一的浮點數。

cues.en: And that's just because the sigmoid functions in a neural network expect or work best with values between zero and one.
cues.zh: 只是因為，神經網路的 Sigmoid 預期，或最適合零到一的值。

cues.en: So we're going to convert the data to floating point and then divide it by two fifty five to get that down to the range of zero to one shift entered care of that.
cues.zh: 因此，轉浮點數，再除以 255，縮到零到一。Shift+Enter，完成。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: A little bit more transformation here.
cues.zh: 再做一點轉換。

cues.en: So we're going to actually reshape that data set to have an extra dimension because that's what our CNN layers in the generator expect.
cues.zh: 為資料集重塑形狀，多加一個維度，因為生成器的 CNN 層，需要這種格式。

cues.en: And at the same time we're going to shuffle that and batch it up so we can do that ahead of time to batch size of 64, yet another hyper parameter.
cues.zh: 同時，先打亂、分成批次，批次大小 64，又是一個超參數。

cues.en: So that's our first one there, guys.
cues.zh: 各位，這是第一個。

cues.en: Like I said, there's a lot of parameters to tune in GANs and we just encountered our first one.
cues.zh: 如前所說，GAN 要調很多參數，現在遇到第一個。

cues.en: Anyway, walking through this, the input images are twenty eight by twenty eight with one channel of color data because they're grayscale and the rest is pretty self-explanatory.
cues.zh: 總之，輸入影像是 28×28，一個色彩通道，因為是灰階，其餘很直觀。

cues.en: Shift enter.
cues.zh: Shift+Enter。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now let's actually start setting up our model.
cues.zh: 現在，開始設定模型。

cues.en: We'll start by defining the generators model.
cues.zh: 先定義生成器模型。

cues.en: So again, this is the model whose job it's going to be to create realistic-looking images of pieces of clothes just given a random input.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，這個模型的任務，是只根據隨機輸入，產生逼真的服裝影像。

cues.en: So we start off by defining the size of that random input.
cues.zh: 先定義隨機輸入大小。

cues.en: And again, this is yet another hyper parameter.
cues.zh: 這又是一個超參數。

cues.en: We're going to start with the value of one hundred and fifty randomly generated noise values, and that will be the input into our generator.
cues.zh: 先用 150 個隨機產生的雜訊值，作為生成器輸入。

cues.en: We set up a sequential model that starts with an input layer of that random noise of 150 values.
cues.zh: 設定 Sequential 模型，從 150 個隨機雜訊值的輸入層開始。

cues.en: We feed that into a dense layer of seven by seven by 256.
cues.zh: 送入 7×7×256 的 Dense 層。

cues.en: We reshape that, plan it out, and then we send that into 3Com, 2D transpose layers.
cues.zh: 重塑形狀、展開，再送入三個 Conv2DTranspose 層。

cues.en: We talked about that earlier.
cues.zh: 前面談過。

cues.en: These are layers that basically build up a larger image from a smaller one or a smaller set of data.
cues.zh: 這些層，基本上從較小影像，或較小資料集合，建立更大影像。

cues.en: And it might be confusing to see this number of filters here actually going down.
cues.zh: 看到濾波器數量反而下降，可能覺得困惑。

cues.en: It's we're creating a larger and larger image, but the number of filters and the size of the resulting image are two different things.
cues.zh: 建立的影像越來越大，但濾波器數量，與結果影像大小，是兩回事。

cues.en: So, you know, don't get too tripped up on that.
cues.zh: 所以，別被困住。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So we're be using the leaky RELU activation function in the generator.
cues.zh: 生成器使用 Leaky ReLU 激活函數。

cues.en: It's just been learned over time that that works the best.
cues.zh: 經驗上，大家逐漸發現它最好。

cues.en: So kind of tribal knowledge there to use leaky relu in the generator when you're dealing with images at least.
cues.zh: 因此，至少處理影像時，生成器用 Leaky ReLU，有點像社群累積的經驗知識。

cues.en: Actually, we also see this in the field of recommender systems, but we haven't talked about using GANs and recommender systems yet.
cues.zh: 其實，推薦系統領域也會看到，但還沒談如何將 GAN 用於推薦系統。

cues.en: We will. Shift enter to get this all set up and we'll print out a summary of the generator model, make sure it looks sane.
cues.zh: 稍後會談。按 Shift+Enter 設定，印出生成器摘要，確認合理。

cues.en: I think it does.
cues.zh: 我覺得是。

cues.en: And now we'll move on to the discriminator model.
cues.zh: 接著，判別器模型。

cues.en: So this one's a little bit more straightforward.
cues.zh: 這個比較直接。

cues.en: We're just going to use old fashioned conv2D layers to try to distill down the generated and real images into some sort of set of latent features that we're going to try to learn.
cues.zh: 只用一般 Conv2D 層，把生成與真實影像，濃縮成要學習的某組潛在特徵。

cues.en: So in this case, our input will be a twenty eight by twenty eight by one image of a piece of clothing or a generated piece of clothing.
cues.zh: 因此，輸入是 28×28×1 的服裝影像，或生成的服裝影像。

cues.en: We'll feed that into two convolution 2D layers, start off with 256 filters down to 128, flatten it out there on a dense layer of sixty four units and we'll add a dropout layer as well to try to prevent
cues.zh: 送入兩個 Conv2D 層，從 256 個濾波器減到 128，再攤平、加 64 個單元的 Dense 層，也加 Dropout，試著避免

cues.en: overfitting and the final output.
cues.zh: 過度擬合。最後輸出，

cues.en: Will just be a yes or no.
cues.zh: 只是是或否。

cues.en: Do I think this is real or fake?
cues.zh: 我認為是真的，還是假的？

cues.en: So that's the structure of this thing here.
cues.zh: 結構就是如此。

cues.en: Oh, and we have yet more hyper parameters here and also in the generator, the topology here, how many layers we have, how big those layers are, what their strides are.
cues.zh: 還有更多超參數，生成器也一樣，包括拓樸、層數、各層大小、步長。

cues.en: These are all things that you need to experiment with.
cues.zh: 這些都需要實驗。

cues.en: And I've already done some experimentation for you.
cues.zh: 我已經先替你做一些。

cues.en: So we will get some reasonable results here in a reasonable amount of time.
cues.zh: 因此，可以在合理時間，得到合理結果。

cues.en: But, you know, you have to experiment with how complex these things are and how much complex do you need and how much is too much.
cues.zh: 但必須實驗：需要多複雜，多少足夠，多少太多。

cues.en: And unfortunately, it's an expensive thing to try to figure out.
cues.zh: 很遺憾，找答案的成本很高。

cues.en: But let's go ahead and set this one up shift enter, put out the summary of the model looks right to me.
cues.zh: 先設定，Shift+Enter，印出摘要，我覺得看來正確。

cues.en: Next, we have to set up our optimizers and our loss functions and our accuracy metrics and, yes, even more hyper parameters to tune, like I said, these things are really delicate.
cues.zh: 接著，設定最佳化器、損失函數、準確率指標；沒錯，又有更多超參數，如前所說，非常敏感。

cues.en: We're gonna set up the optimizer for the generator optimizer, G, with the atom optimizer with a learning rate of zero point zero zero zero zero one.
cues.zh: 為生成器設定 optimizer_G，使用 Adam，學習率 0.00001。

cues.en: And that's going to be an important hyper parameter.
cues.zh: 這是重要超參數。

cues.en: Similarly, the learning rate on the discriminator, we're sending that to point .00003.
cues.zh: 同樣，判別器的學習率，設為 0.00003。

cues.en: And again, that's just a value that you have to adjust through experimentation.
cues.zh: 同樣，只能透過實驗調整。

cues.en: Fortunately, the classifier is pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 幸好，分類器很直接。

cues.en: We're just trying to figure out if the discriminator can figure out if these images are real or fake.
cues.zh: 只想知道，判別器能否分辨影像真或假。

cues.en: And binary cross-entropy fits the bill there and binary accuracy fits the bill for our accuracy metric.
cues.zh: 因此，損失函數用 binary_crossentropy，準確率指標用 binary_accuracy。

cues.en: So at least that's not too tough to figure out.
cues.zh: 至少這不難選。

cues.en: This is actually a lot harder and variation of auto encoders, but in this example, it's a little bit simpler.
cues.zh: 在變分自編碼器中，其實難很多，但這個例子簡單一點。

cues.en: Shift enter.
cues.zh: Shift+Enter。

cues.en: Got that all set up.
cues.zh: 設定好了。

cues.en: All right, let's start tying it all together.
cues.zh: 現在，開始串起來。

cues.en: So let's start by defining the training function for the discriminator.
cues.zh: 先定義判別器的訓練函數。

cues.en: So we start by reading off this shape of the data being fed into it, so we'll extract whatever the bat sizes, I think we actually ended up adjusting that to 64 of twenty-eight by twenty-eight by one
cues.zh: 讀取輸入資料形狀，擷取批次大小，我想最後調成 64 張 28×28×1 的

cues.en: images.
cues.zh: 影像。

cues.en: And then we generate our random noise inputs for however many we have in the batch and for whatever dimension of noise that we selected earlier.
cues.zh: 接著，依批次數量，以及之前選的雜訊維度，產生隨機雜訊輸入。

cues.en: Hundred and fifty.
I think we set that too.
cues.zh: 我想設定的是這個。

cues.en: So that's our random noise.
cues.zh: 這就是隨機雜訊。

cues.en: Note that we're actually selecting a Gaussian random normal distribution here for our noise.
cues.zh: 注意，這裡選高斯常態分布的隨機雜訊。

cues.en: You could experiment with that too.
cues.zh: 這也能實驗。

cues.en: Yet another thing to experiment with, maybe a uniform distribution would be more interesting.
cues.zh: 又一個可實驗的選項，也許均勻分布更有意思。

cues.en: I don't know.
cues.zh: 我不知道。

cues.en: Try it out.
cues.zh: 試試看。

cues.en: Next, we need to generate our real and fake labels so that we're trying to measure our accuracy against.
cues.zh: 接著，產生真、假標籤，用來衡量準確程度。

cues.en: So what we're going to do is basically concatenate together, are generated images, and are real images together.
cues.zh: 基本上，將生成影像與真實影像串接。

cues.en: So we'll start off with the real images.
cues.zh: 先從真實影像開始。

cues.en: So we're going to have labels of one attached to all of our real images because we know they're real.
cues.zh: 替所有真實影像標上一，因為知道是真的。

cues.en: Then we're going to stick a bunch of zeros at the end for the fake images that are coming from our generator.
cues.zh: 接著，在尾端加上一串零，代表來自生成器的假影像。

cues.en: So these labels will be used to train the discriminator as to whether or not it's guessing.
cues.zh: 用這些標籤訓練判別器，判斷猜得對不對，

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 是否正確，

cues.en: As to whether an image is real or fake.
cues.zh: 也就是影像真或假。

cues.en: Next, we explicitly set up how our training works with a gradient tape.
cues.zh: 接著，用 GradientTape，明確設定訓練方式。

cues.en: We will generate our fake samples by passing that noise that we generated into the generator function.
cues.zh: 把產生的雜訊，傳入生成器函數，產生假樣本。

cues.en: And they'll be our fake images will then concatenate those fake images with our real images that are being fed into it and stick them all together and put them into the discriminator.
cues.zh: 得到假影像後，與傳入的真影像串接，全部放一起，送入判別器。

cues.en: And that discriminator will give us back a vector of all the predictions as to whether it thinks those images are real or fake.
cues.zh: 判別器傳回預測向量，表示認為各影像是真或假。

cues.en: We then calculate the loss as to whether it got it right against the actual known labels as to whether the they are from the generator or from real data.
cues.zh: 再對照已知的真實標籤，計算猜對與否的損失；知道它們是生成器產生，還是真資料。

cues.en: And the rest is kind of boilerplate stuff.
cues.zh: 其餘有點像固定格式。

cues.en: We just feed that discriminator lost function into our gradient tape and apply the gradients pretty much boilerplate stuff.
cues.zh: 把判別器損失函數送進 GradientTape，套用梯度，基本上是固定格式。

cues.en: Reporter accuracy and return the values that we want to track over time so we can actually visualize the training of this thing as we go.
cues.zh: 回報準確率，傳回想隨時間追蹤的值，才能視覺化訓練過程。

cues.en: So let's shift enter and set that all up.
cues.zh: Shift+Enter，設定。

cues.en: And similarly, let's set up our generator as well.
cues.zh: 同樣，設定生成器。

cues.en: So remember, its job is to not get caught by the discriminator.
cues.zh: 記得，任務是不要被判別器抓到。

cues.en: So, again, we're going to start with our vector of random noise for whatever that size is.
cues.zh: 同樣，先建立指定大小的隨機雜訊向量。

cues.en: And this time we're just going to be setting our labels to one.
cues.zh: 這次，標籤一律設為一。

cues.en: The reason for that being is that we're trying to maximize the probability that its output is classified as real.
cues.zh: 因為想最大化輸出被分類為真的機率。

cues.en: So our job is for the discriminator to come back with a classification of one.
cues.zh: 所以，目標是讓判別器傳回分類一。

cues.en: That's the thinking there between what our labels are here that we're training it on.
cues.zh: 這就是設定訓練標籤的思考。

cues.en: So again, we'll set up a gradient tape for training.
cues.zh: 同樣，設定 GradientTape 訓練。

cues.en: We're going to take the generated noise and pass it into our generator and then in turn, take those generated images and feed them into the discriminator.
cues.zh: 把雜訊送入生成器，再將生成影像，送入判別器。

cues.en: And then we'll calculate the loss on the generator as to whether or not it actually tricked the discriminator successfully or not.
cues.zh: 根據是否成功欺騙判別器，計算生成器損失。

cues.en: OK, so not a lot of code there for kind of a complicated idea, but that's all there is to it.
cues.zh: 概念複雜，但程式碼不多，就是這樣。

cues.en: We then pass that lost function into the gradient tape, just like we did before for the discriminator and updated state.
cues.zh: 再像先前判別器一樣，把損失函數送進 GradientTape，更新狀態。

cues.en: Keep track of the loss and accuracy over time so we can actually report that and visualize it if we want to. Shift enter.
cues.zh: 隨時間記錄損失與準確率，供回報與視覺化。Shift+Enter。

cues.en: All right, so at this point, again, we have our generator that's being trained on how to convince realistic fakes that are fooling the discriminator into thinking that it's real, and we have a discriminator
cues.zh: 此時，生成器正在學習產生逼真假影像，讓判別器以為是真的；同時，判別器，

cues.en: that's being trained on how to successfully tell the real difference between real images and generated images.
cues.zh: 正在學習成功區分真實影像與生成影像。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Let's set up a little handy dandy helper function here to plot a given image as we train it.
cues.zh: 設定方便的小輔助函數，在訓練時畫出影像。
